summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Brainsway Ltd. announcing positive real-world data from a study of Deep TMS in patients with comorbid PTSD and MDD. No M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is involved. The registrant is the issuer reporting clinical data, not a party to any transaction. The exhibit contains a press release with study results. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics typical of a special-situation filing. This is a routine disclosure of scientific findings, not a corporate event requiring special-situation classification.
